notes: 0.3.43：根外路径清单只在「接收方」提示，并直接给推荐目录。清单是推送时写的，本机自己推出去的路径在本机当然都在，摊在自己面板上只会像故障（实测 50 条里 40 多条是会话缓存）。现在报告带 machine：本机写的 → 不显示、也不计入告警；别的机器写的 → 显示「这份配置是 X 推送的」，并逐条给推荐目录（先按对方根值做前缀映射，保留原大小写；无根可映射就按目录名在本机各根/用户目录/桌面/盘根找同名目录；都没有就明说没有等价目录），每行一个「采纳」直接记进本机自选目录，下次推送起变占位符。清单只扫配置类文件（settings/profile/skills/presets/prompt/顶层 json），会话、工作区、记忆不再参与；`s://` 这类协议头误匹配也过滤掉了。
notesEn: 0.3.43: the stray-path report now speaks to the receiving machine only, and suggests a folder per entry. The list is written during a push, and paths this machine pushed obviously exist here, so showing them locally only looks like a fault (40+ of 50 entries were session-cache noise). The report now carries `machine`: written by this machine -> hidden and not counted as a warning; written by another machine -> "this config was pushed from X" plus a suggested folder per entry (prefix mapping through the remote root values with original case preserved; otherwise a same-named folder under this machine's roots / user profile / Desktop / drive roots; otherwise it says there is no equivalent). Each row has Accept, which records that folder as a custom root so the next push turns them into placeholders. The scan covers config files only (settings/profile/skills/presets/prompt/top-level json) - sessions, workspaces and memory no longer participate - and `s://`-style protocol false positives are filtered out.
